# Source.io

> Source.io is an AI-powered active learning workspace that transforms dense textbooks, lecture audio recordings, and scientific research papers into structured notes, 3D flashcards, practice quizzes, and dual-host audio recaps—with every claim, definition, and formula anchored to its exact source coordinate.

## Core Value Proposition
- **Grounded Verification**: Unlike generic LLMs that hallucinate, Source.io indexes source documents with page numbers, paragraph positions, and audio timestamps. Every generated insight cites its exact source.
- **Five Coordinated Study Modes**: Convert any document or recording into Structured Notes, Spaced Repetition Leitner Flashcards, Practice Quizzes with explanations, Studio Audio Recaps, and Grounded Source Chat.
- **Privacy & Security**: Zero-retention policy. Uploaded documents, lecture recordings, and notes are never retained to train commercial AI models.
- **Transparent Pricing**: Real Free Forever tier (25 actions/day), $9/mo Scholar Pass, and Developer BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) mode.

## Product Features & Specifications

### 1. Structured Study Notes
- Automatic hierarchical synthesis (Core Concepts, Mathematical Formulations, Key Takeaways).
- Native KaTeX rendering for complex formulas and physics equations.
- In-line citation badges linking directly to source PDF bounding boxes and paragraphs.
- One-click export to standard clean Markdown.

### 2. Spaced Repetition Leitner Flashcards
- Front-and-back concept cards generated directly from key document definitions.
- Leitner 5-box spaced repetition algorithm with recall accuracy tracking.
- Interactive 3D flip physics with keyboard accessibility (Space to flip, 1-4 for difficulty rating).

### 3. Practice Quizzes & Diagnostic Tests
- Multiple-choice and short-answer questions targeted at key concepts and edge cases.
- Comprehensive explanations for both correct and incorrect choices.
- Immediate coordinate proof displaying the exact source paragraph supporting the correct answer.

### 4. Audio Recaps & Podcasts
- Dual-voice conversational audio summaries discussing paper methodologies and lecture topics.
- Synchronized waveform playback with interactive transcripts.
- Commute-ready study format with time-stamped topic jumps.

### 5. Grounded Source Chat
- Direct conversation with documents using vector embedding retrieval.
- Cosine similarity matching (typically 90%+ similarity threshold).
- Quotation highlights and passage coordinates returned alongside each response.

## Supported Ingestion Formats
- **PDF Documents**: Research papers, syllabi, textbooks up to 50MB (100 pages free, 300 pages Scholar).
- **Audio & Video**: MP3, WAV, M4A, MP4 recordings with automatic Whisper speech-to-text.
- **Web & Lectures**: YouTube lecture URLs, clean web articles, Word (.docx), and Markdown/text files.

## Pricing Summary
- **Free Forever**: $0/mo — 25 daily AI actions (resets 00:00 UTC), 3 document slots, all 5 study modes, no credit card.
- **Scholar Pass**: $9/mo — Unlimited priority generations, unlimited storage, 300-page books, studio audio.
- **BYOK (Bring Your Own Key)**: $0 — Connect personal Gemini or Groq API key for unlimited generations.
